metadata.name: Eagle Spires
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A sniper’s alpine valley. Embers and Tide each hold a 40 m mesa with a ruined lookout tower and their flag, roped by plank bridges to two flank spires with stilted sniper nests. Jump-pad chains climb every top over wooden scaffolds, zipline pads throw you back down, and gliders wait on the peaks; every round starts with a parachute drop from a transport plane. The 64 m Eagle Spire holds the railgun over a river island, two cave spires have shotgun tunnels right through them, and dropships and hover bikes wait in the forested, misty valley.
